subtopics.name: Introduction to Neural Networks
subtopics.content: Array traversal refers to visiting each element of an array one by one to perform operations such as reading, updating, or computing values. Basic operations on arrays include insertion, deletion, updating elements, and calculating values like sum, minimum, and maximum. Understanding traversal and these fundamental operations is essential for solving many programming problems efficiently.

subtopics.name: Perceptron
subtopics.content: Searching in arrays involves finding the position of a specific element. The most basic method is linear search, which checks each element sequentially. For sorted arrays, binary search can be used to reduce search time significantly by repeatedly dividing the search space in half. Understanding these searching techniques helps improve algorithm efficiency.

These problems help develop strong skills in in-place algorithms and efficient array manipulation.
